issues.detail: Task T6 is listed in artifacts_to_reference for TH5 but never appears in any artifact_refs within the thread's messages.
The text contains forbidden terms: 'score' (M8), 'performance' (M67, M68, M73), and 'scenario' (M50, M78, M94).

Multiple participants use the exact same robotic phrasing to provide feedback across different threads (e.g., 'I've reviewed A1', 'I've reviewed A2', 'I've reviewed A6', 'I've reviewed A5', 'I've reviewed A4').
TH5 has 30 messages, which is significantly higher than the target range of 17-24.
